description: This file contains utility functions for domain validation related to chatflows, including domain permission checks, extracting chatflow IDs from URLs, and generating error messages for unauthorized origins.

methods.name: validateChatflowDomain
methods.description: Validates if the origin URL is allowed for a specific chatflow based on its configuration.

methods.name: extractChatflowId
methods.description: Extracts the chatflow ID from a prediction URL.

methods.name: isPredictionRequest
methods.description: Checks if a URL corresponds to a prediction request.

methods.name: getUnauthorizedOriginError
methods.description: Retrieves a custom error message for unauthorized origin access to a chatflow.
